recipeModeConclusion: HD guide distinguishes an owned Recipes tab from custom creation. Named-recipe guidance now requires obtaining and selecting the recipe item. No raw ingredient event receives an unconditional 100% guarantee; custom-selection semantics for the three colliding events remain open.

boardAdapterFinding.interpretation: The disconnection comes from our reciprocal-only adapter, not proof of a locked in-game branch. Expose the explicit one-sided source connector separately and preserve its evidence limit. A-3 Magic Boost is already reachable from A-2.
boardAdapterFinding.hdImageInspection: Cloud browser remained on Cloudflare security verification after one reload; no board image inspected. HD indexed LP totals agree (Jestabocky1080, AuraLion1940), but totals alone do not establish the exact connector/coordinate.
boardAdapterFinding.resolution: Resolved source-backed extraction defect: source connectors are undirected adjacency, so an explicit B-3 Left connector is sufficient to include A-3/B-3. Normalize it while retaining the missing reciprocal graphic. All54 source-reported boards are connected; this does not certify Aura Lion’s separate transformation footnote.

daringDiver.aggregation: Sum of retained high scores across both characters/world courses, not lifetime sum of repeat runs.
daringDiver.inspection: Indexed HD Reports section explicitly specifies total High Score for both characters on each World. Full site browser blocked; no claimed Steam measurement.

portalFarming.inspection: Indexed full PS4 Q&A answers and 2017 HD board thread posts4,7,10 inspected. Independent player instructions describe staying by the target portal and dropping away/back for repeated material clears; post7 explicitly is not postgame.
portalFarming.route: Riku, TWTNW Special3, Delusive Beginning, Tyranto Rex / Prehistoric fiend. Unlock with Specials1 and2, then cycle Drops and repeat the active Special for Brilliant Fantasy. Sora’s Special3 in Avenue to Dreams supplies Wild Fantasy.

supplyCheck.basis: Arithmetic from the three checked-in marked formulas. Farm until inventory covers the target; no finite first-clear-only assumption.

portalFarming.conflict: Earlier guide wording suggests all Specials must be cleared before revisiting. HD repeated-farming reports do not impose that gate; do not promote an all39 prerequisite. Exact earliest replay gate and every other payout state remain unverified.

goldenEgg.guarantee: Either outcome has ★ rank; no particular breed is guaranteed. This does not resolve the three separate custom-input selection conflicts in DDD-006.
goldenEgg.derivation: Both ingredient totals are twice their base quantities, so the lesser-ingredient rule still grants +2 ranks. B → A → ★; S is the source name for the star rank, not an additional intermediate rank.
goldenEgg.inspection: PS4 HD v1.05 guide Golden Egg section inspected in full through web tool on 2026-10-02. Live Spirit rank/extra-material rules and canonical breed formula rows corroborate the result.
